elements.text:
Know → possess information
Discover → obtain knowledge through interaction
Understand → see the mechanism
Predict → use the mechanism to anticipate outcomes
Generate → use the model to produce an intended result
Critique → test the model's validity and limits
Derive → reach deeper principles from which the model follows
Unify → find principles shared across different models
Create → produce a genuinely new model, method, or structure

elements.text:
The three dimensions
Relatedness → "Does this matter to me?"
Connection between the action and what you value/care about.
Autonomy → "Am I choosing this?"
The action is experienced as self-directed rather than imposed.
Competence → "Can I do this?"
You possess—or are developing—the understanding and ability required for the action.
So you get:
Relatedness = WHY
Autonomy = CHOICE - what to do?
Competence = HOW

And when all three converge:
WHY + CHOICE + HOW → ACTION
